text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин and Бива Хаяхидэ both
fail to win
the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This loss and the difficulties she faced in
training
weigh heavily on Нарита Таисин,
and she breaks
from mental and physical
exhaustion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She confesses that she needs a break
from both
training and racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
